title: Ecommerce Google Shopping Ads: Start With Standard Shopping

facts.fact: The article was published on October 11, 2026, by David Smania, Founder of BrandRocket.
The page lists a reading time of 9 minutes for this article.
This is Chapter 06 of a 16-chapter guide titled Google Ads for Ecommerce.
In the BrandRocket case example, the One Fly Shop store ran at least 30 Shopping ads and only 4 text ads.
facts.quote: One Fly Shop Ran at Least 30 Shopping Ads and Just 4 Text Ads.

facts.fact: The guide's chapter 10 is titled 'Performance Max After 30 Sales,' a heading that names a 30-sale threshold without stating its basis in the visible text.
